deliverables: multi-VIP disambiguation: CT-hit and pending-hit paths now compare the bound (listen_addr, listen_port) against the packet destination; mismatch -> nat_conflict counter + REJECTED/NAT_CONFLICT flow event + explicit userspace fallback instead of silent rebind
snat_release rollback: a claimed SNAT port is released when the owning CT/pending insert fails (all four insert-failure sites), so map insert failure no longer leaks ports
pending expiry releases its SNAT binding in-datapath (previously orphaned until the sweeper pass) and emits XDP_FLOW_EVENT_EXPIRED

sweeper orphan check tightened: live sets track each entry's claimed snat_port; a binding survives only while its owning flow is live AND still claims that port (tuple reuse on a new port frees the old binding; a re-claimed port stays protected)
XdpCounters.nat_conflict (ABI v10, 232B) plumbed to status + dump-maps; XDP_DECISION_NAT_CONFLICT=10 pinned append-only
billing: FLOW_ACCT bidirectional accounting verified per flow with server attribution intact (rx/tx bytes + server_id observable via bpftool/dump)

pending promotion no longer mutates the pending record before the authoritative CT insert: the record is inserted verbatim and flipped to OPEN only on success, so a full CT table leaves the pending state AND its absolute deadline untouched (retransmitted ACKs cannot extend half-open lifetime or wedge the entry)

test-only fault injection: XdpPendingCap.flags (debugFailFlags config) forces CT-insert / pending-insert / SNAT-alloc failure paths without filling production maps — exercised live in probe phases E/F/G

sweeper GC bounds: per-map reap cap 4096/round with guaranteed progress (deferred stales are collected first next round), stale membership moved to HashSet (was O(flows x stale) Vec scan), conditional remove re-validates last_seen so a concurrent refresh / tuple re-admission between scan and delete cannot kill the newer entry
billing aggregation is per-server_id batched per sweep round (bounded by distinct servers, no per-flow metric calls, no dropped deltas)
sync_pending_cap moved from the 5s sweeper tick to attach time (config-derived, pinned map) so in-map fault flags are not clobbered between sweeps

verification.verifier: object loads on kernel 7.0.14-orbstack x86-build; pending_touch returns u64-packed triple to avoid sret caller-stack pointer rejected by verifier
verification.probe: en11_nat_probe all 7 phases pass: A UDP conflict, B TCP pending conflict, C expiry port release, D billing, E CT-insert-fail rollback + retry, F pending-insert-fail SNAT rollback, G SNAT exhaustion
verification.regression: en10_flow_probe re-run green on the v10 object (takeover + event channel unchanged)

limitations: concurrent-promotion (two CPUs racing the same tuple) is covered by BPF_NOEXIST on insert + single-writer pending entry; not separately instrumented
conflict rejection semantics = explicit userspace fallback (Ok(None)), consistent with the CT-full contract; counted and evented, not silent
veth/netns evidence; real-NIC multi-queue SNAT pressure untested
TTL decrement absent by design (same-subnet L2 rewrite); neighbor via configured nextHopMac
